cass-property-addresses.geojson.query: where 1=1, geometry = DNR Major 8 'Leech Lake River' (HUC8 07010102) polygon from watershed-whole-basin.geojson, spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects; full 4,776-vertex polygon
cass-property-addresses.geojson.caveats: Property Address Information (911 addressing). OWNAME and all OWADR/OWZIP owner-address fields dropped. PHYSADDR is the point's own street address (the feature's identity), kept; no owner name is stored. FIELD FENCE: owner/taxpayer names, mailing/situs addresses, EMV/valuation, tax amounts/balances, mortgage/payment details and staff/editor names were NOT requested or stored.
